name: rails
description: function hooks that keep Bash commands on the rails: gh always runs under an explicit GH_PERSONA, rm of anything that cannot be regenerated becomes rkvr rmrf, a pkill -f pattern is bracketed so it cannot kill its own shell, and each rule in ~/repos/.claude/routed (which nothing else loads) reaches the model when the trigger its load: names fires

gh_persona.title: gh persona
gh_persona.description: Inject GH_PERSONA=work|home into every gh invocation the Bash tool runs. Underscore because the plugin schema rejects hyphens in these keys.

rm_rkvr.title: rm to rkvr rmrf
rm_rkvr.description: Rewrite an rm of anything outside the regenerable build-output set to rkvr rmrf, and deny the wrapper forms that delete through another command (rules/safety.md). Underscore because the plugin schema rejects hyphens in these keys.

excluded_compound.title: excluded-compound deny
excluded_compound.description: Deny a command that mixes a sandbox.excludedCommands stage with a stage that is not excluded, which would otherwise carry the whole compound out of the sandbox with no prompt. Underscore because the plugin schema rejects hyphens in these keys.

pkill_bracket.title: pkill -f bracket
pkill_bracket.description: Bracket the first character of a pkill -f pattern (quartz.*4173 -> [q]uartz.*4173) so it cannot match the Bash tool's own shell, and deny a pattern outside the rewritable subset (an alternation, a leading metacharacter) with the bracketed form named. Underscore because the plugin schema rejects hyphens in these keys.

rule_routing.title: rule routing
rule_routing.description: Inject each rule in ~/repos/.claude/routed (which nothing else loads) once per context, when its prompt, tool or Bash trigger fires; gate outward tools until their rule is in context. Turning it off flushes every routed rule whole into each loop at its next prompt or tool call instead. Underscore because the plugin schema rejects hyphens in these keys.

debug.title: debug
debug.description: Log every decision to the transcript and the --debug log
